posts.cooked:
Krayden006:

Out of sheer curiosity, why doesn't anyone use east coast/gulf coast ports?  I realize that coming from China would entail sailing around South America or using the Panama Canal.  I have no knowlegde of shipping logistics.  Just curious.

 

The Panams Canal Expansion Project is currently ongoing, you can read about it Here.  It is going to open the canal to large shipping vessels, which currently can't go through.

Until then the Port of Los Angeles and the Port of Long Beach are the only option for Shipping across the Pacific.  Going around South America is not a viable option.

The trouble is the Dockworkers and the Port Management have been at an impasse for a long time.  The monopoly on shipping the port enjoys gives them little motivation to improve on anything.  

The Workers have been working without a contract, and are unhappy.  Management says they are working slow and causing the trouble.

The Workers in replay blame the Port for ignoring needed upgrades and improvements for too long, and the problem has been building and is hitting a head with this christmas season.

It looks like both sides have good points, and mostly we can know that Monopolies crush innovation and motivation, and the Panama Canal project just needs to get finished so there are other options.

I'm sorry. I don't seem to have been clear.

We already have a separate forum for each game (SotM, Tactics, GSF) and a separate forum for discussing Sentinels Comics - lore which is common to multiple games. 

What I'm seeing now is a call for each game (SotM, Tactics, GSF) to have two separate forums: One for Rules and one for Other/General related to that game.

I personally don't see the appeal of having two separate forums for each game -- I would be perfectly happy with the status quo of jumbling the rules questions in with everything else that's specific to an individual game. Others, however, seem to like the idea of separating any Topics related to Rules from everything else.

So, I'd be happy to see opinions about which you'd prefer:

A) One forum for each game, plus a forum for Sentinel Comics lore (as we have now)

B) Two forums for each game, dividing Rules from General, plus a forum for Sentinel Comics lore.

C) Something else.
